chunks.meaning: 缓和紧张局面；给争论降温
chunks.note: 这里的 temperature 是冲突强度，不是实际温度；说话时还需把前面的口语长句整理清楚。
chunks.quote: bring down the temperature.
chunks.transfer: Let's bring down the temperature and focus on what we can fix.

chunks.meaning: 消除疑虑、结束争论，使某个问题不再反复被提起
chunks.note: 不等于每一种 solve；常配 doubts、fears、rumors、questions。原句用 lay to rest the question，宾语较长所以后置。
chunks.quote: I also hope we can lay to rest the question about the integrity of the American electoral system.
chunks.transfer: The new evidence should lay those doubts to rest.

chunks.meaning: 让每一天／每一刻都有价值；充分利用时间
chunks.note: count 在此是有价值、产生作用，不是计数；不是 every 后可随意装任何名词的万能结构。
chunks.quote: Let's make every day count.
chunks.transfer: We only have a week left, so let's make every day count.

chunks.meaning: 保持信心，别因受挫而放弃相信
chunks.note: faith 在此可指信心，不必指宗教；日常更直白可说 don't lose hope。
chunks.quote: And above all, we need to keep the faith.
chunks.transfer: It's been a difficult year, but I'm trying to keep the faith.

chunks.meaning: 不论输赢；输赢都一样适用
chunks.note: 可放句首或句尾补充条件；不是句式骨架 only when 的同义替换，而是把相反条件都纳入。
chunks.quote: And it can be trusted, win or lose.
chunks.transfer: Win or lose, I'm glad we gave it a try.

chunks.meaning: 达到理想、承诺或期待的标准
chunks.note: 不是住在某地；常说 live up to expectations 或 live up to a promise。
chunks.quote: We've never fully lived up to that idea, but we've never walked away from it.
chunks.transfer: The product didn't live up to my expectations.

chunks.meaning: 这么做会自担危险／后果；带警告
chunks.note: 比 at one's own risk 更带危险感，不宜用于每件小事。
chunks.quote: We lose these institutions of our government at our own peril.
chunks.transfer: We ignore these warning signs at our own peril.

chunks.meaning: 如果……我会很意外；间接表示自己觉得那不太可能
chunks.note: if 从句的肯定／否定决定预测方向；原句的 anything different 表示预计别人也听到相同担忧。
chunks.quote: I'd be surprised if you heard anything different than the concern about: Are we okay?
chunks.transfer: I'd be surprised if we finished this by Friday.

chunks.meaning: 尽管它有种种缺点，仍然……
chunks.note: for all 在此表达让步，不是为了全部；换对象时可用 for all his/her/their faults。原文 pass 后附官方 path 更正，照录。
chunks.quote: For all its faults though, American democracy remains the best pass [path; White House correction] forward to prosperity, possibilities, progress, fair play, equality.
chunks.transfer: For all its faults, this is still the tool I use most.

chunks.meaning: 玩笑归玩笑，认真地说……
chunks.note: 用来从玩笑切回认真话题；没有玩笑铺垫时不必硬用。原句后续 more ... as ... 是口语中的不整齐比较结构，不作为模板；这里只收话题切换词块。
chunks.quote: But, all kidding aside, I've never been more optimistic about America's chances in domestic and foreign policy as I am today.
chunks.transfer: All kidding aside, I really appreciate your help.

chunks.chunk: The real credit doesn't go to [X]
chunks.meaning: 真正的功劳不属于 X（而应归给别人）
chunks.note: credit 是功劳、认可，不是贷款额度；原段下一句把认可给了听众。
chunks.quote: But the real credit doesn't go to me and my administration for the progress—for this progress.
chunks.transfer: The real credit doesn't go to me; it goes to the people who tested it.

chunks.meaning: X 从来不是理所当然或自动有保证的
chunks.note: a given 作名词指可当成既定事实的东西；不能理解为过去分词被给予。
chunks.quote: greatness is never a given.
chunks.transfer: Trust is never a given; you have to earn it.

chunks.meaning: 接受更低的标准或次一等的结果；将就
chunks.note: settle for 指接受不那么理想的选项；less 的比较标准由语境给出。
chunks.quote: Our journey has never been one of shortcuts or settling for less.
chunks.transfer: We don't have to settle for less just because we're in a hurry.

chunks.chunk: The question is not whether [A], but whether [B]
chunks.meaning: 真正要问的不是 A，而是 B；重新界定讨论焦点
chunks.note: whether A/B 可各接一个完整判断；不只是替换 but，而是在转移判定标准。
chunks.quote: The question we ask today is not whether our Government is too big or too small, but whether it works;
chunks.transfer: The question is not whether we can build it, but whether anyone needs it.

chunks.meaning: 不是出于 X，而是因为 Y；澄清动机
chunks.note: out of 在此引出动机，X 常为情绪或态度名词，Y 为从句；不要照抄原政治主张。
chunks.quote: not out of charity, but because it is the surest route to our common good.
chunks.transfer: I asked not out of curiosity, but because I needed to make a decision.

chunks.meaning: 帮助某人撑过困难时期
chunks.note: 不是看穿某人；与 see through an excuse（识破借口）区分。原句包含 which 回指，不能把截取片段当完整句。
chunks.quote: which sees us through our darkest hours.
chunks.transfer: Her support saw me through a very difficult year.

chunks.meaning: 光说不做；只会嘴上说
chunks.note: 带明确负面评价；评价同事时可能显得尖锐。
chunks.quote: We will no longer accept politicians who are all talk and no action, constantly complaining, but never doing anything about it.
chunks.transfer: He makes big promises, but he's all talk and no action.

chunks.meaning: 把任务完成；重点在结果
chunks.note: job 可以是具体任务，不一定是职业岗位；不自动表示完成得好。
chunks.quote: We will face challenges, we will confront hardships, but we will get the job done.
chunks.transfer: It isn't perfect, but it gets the job done.

chunks.meaning: 让某人失望；辜负其期待
chunks.note: 此处不是物理上放下人；ever 强化原句的承诺。
chunks.quote: I will fight for you with every breath in my body, and I will never, ever let you down.
chunks.transfer: I know you were counting on me, and I'm sorry I let you down.

chunks.meaning: 没有容纳 X 的余地；某种态度或行为不应存在
chunks.note: 可字面指空间，也可抽象表达不容许；no room for error 表示不允许出错。
chunks.quote: When you open your heart to patriotism, there is no room for prejudice.
chunks.transfer: There's no room for personal attacks in this discussion.

skipped.text: You can't love your country only when you win. / You can't love your neighbor only when you agree.
skipped.reason: 收集箱已有同一 You can't ... only when ... 骨架；保留旧例句，邻居变体不重复计数。

skipped.text: What truly matters is not which party controls our Government, but whether our Government is controlled by the people.
skipped.reason: 与本批 The question is not whether ... but whether ... 同属重新定焦动作；保留一条代表，此句留作变体。

skipped.text: Make America great again / America first
skipped.reason: 依赖特定政治运动的口号；不适合作为日常表达的默认学习项。

skipped.text: not simply because ... but because ... / not only ... but ...
skipped.reason: 常见对比与成对连接，已有一般性教材；本批优先选更有独立使用边界的表达。
